_note: Address-the-player rides a planned voice: lead DM Narrator, director on (storyOrchestratorDebugDirectorResponse picks Arin), address_player after 1 player turn. The first voice the director picks is Arin, a non-lead member, so the one-shot ask rides it: the speech record holds an address event for Arin with recipient player, instructed and yield-after, whether or not the no-model lane renders the reply (a failed generation is recorded as an attempt with no message). No extra voice is started for it. Assumes the no-model lane runs the group wrapper and the talk interceptor; if it does not, run on a model lane. Written for v3.0 plan 19 stage 2, NOT YET RUN (the live gate is owed); schema-validated only.

requires.why: the decision and the speech record are code; the reply text is not asserted

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugDirectorResponse = 'SPEAKER: Arin'; return { director: 'Arin' };

qualities.rubric: Has the party reached the gate?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const speech = rt.extras.speech ?? []; const address = speech.filter((e) => e.origin === 'address'); const state = { address, speech, decisions: rt.getTalkState().decisions.slice(-4) }; if (address.length !== 1 || address[0].member !== 'Arin' || address[0].recipient !== 'player' || !address[0].instructed || !address[0].yieldAfter) throw new Error('one address event for Arin expected: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (speech.filter((e) => e.send === address[0].send && e.origin !== 'entry').length > 1) throw new Error('the address beat must ride a voice, not add one: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); return state;
